subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, completely black eyes with no whites, late thirties with forehead wrinkles, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body turned three quarters to the right, head facing the camera straight on, completely black eyes staring straight into the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: the smile suddenly drops: with a blank, cold face he stares straight into the camera and speaks slowly in a low voice, the mouth opening and closing in small slow movements; the head tilts slightly down and stays still; one hand slowly leaves the other and raises its index finger toward the camera; then the smile returns as he settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
